events.title: Steam Next Fest & Achievements update!
events.summary: Hi everyone!Today we're happy to announce that Abort Sequence will take part in the upcoming Steam Next Fest (Oct 19 - Oct 26 at 10AM PT), and in preparation for the event we decided to add a little something to further polish the experience for those who will try the demo.Along with little tweaks here and there, we added a Codex to keep track of the modules you have solved, and 13 new achievements for anyone wanting to have a more traditional way of reaching the 100% completion :DOf course the

events.title: First Demo Update
events.summary: The first few days of the demo have been super busy for us, as we did our best to gather the feedback and make changes where they were needed. There are still a few things to adjust (which we'll get back on next week), but for now here's what we did: - we tutorialized the training a bit more, adding a module that will give basic instructions on how to read the codeblock - we added a spawn system for filler items based on completed matches (because the difficulty selection desk was a bit empty) -

events.title: The Demo is finally out!
events.summary: We've been hard at work to make the Demo for Abort Sequence as polished as we could, and while we still have a long way to go, we can finally (and proudly) share our effort so far!There are still a lot of details to refine, and we'll definitely update the demo during the coming months to include some more "advanced modules", but you will get more info on those when the time comes >:)Of course don't forget to add Abort Sequence to your wishlist, share your feedback with us through the discussions
